decisions.decision: Build and prove the common V2 optimization harness on pre-2023 development evidence only; preserve V1 unchanged and prohibit reserved-confirmation, true-forward, paper, SIM and LIVE evidence from search.

Carry market_structure.open_interest, market_structure.positioning, ta.oscillator_mean_reversion, ta.range_breakout, ta.trend_strength, and ta.volume_confirmation forward as development-supported matched marginal feature families for downstream model/regime/risk work; do not treat retention as protected-confirmation validation or as evidence of uniformly positive value across every outer block.

Do not retain carry/basis, curve, trend-momentum, or volatility-envelope families for unconditional matched marginal credit in issue448; preserve them only as bounded downstream conditional/regime-role candidates without rewriting the issue448 result.

Keep event timing, storage consensus surprise, and options-implied activation on HOLD until their registered PIT/source gates are proven; authorize no billable options acquisition from issue448. Volatility/tail specialists remain admissible only in roles supported by downstream evidence.

Retain `both__strength_q50__f1.00__loss_cooldown_3_sessions__short_none__long_veto` as the strongest development-only joint candidate from #459: +0.324275 percentage points/month mean outer improvement, with positive deltas in both development outers. This is not protected-confirmation evidence and its components remain subject to causal adaptive re-selection in #465.

Preserve #429's `NO_ISSUE429_LIFECYCLE_IMPROVEMENT` result for the tested static lifecycle variants. Strength gating, loss cooldown, and the long specialist veto remain evidenced contributors to the parent, while dynamic lifecycle and existing-position actions are reopened only as distinct hypotheses under #465.

Retain `regime_favored1_50_other0_75` as the #430 development sizing candidate: +0.1276375 percentage points/month mean outer improvement versus the inherited parent, with no promoted incremental Stage-2 risk-control rule. Treat fixed exposure scaling as amplification rather than new directional edge.

Retain `decay20` as a strong development adaptation clue: +0.4456875 percentage points/month versus fixed adaptation and positive in both development outers. Preserve the final #431 HOLD because the advantage failed every tested one-session-delay cross-execution configuration; exact source/event timing remains unproven.

Make #465 the final broad V2 development stage before #414: model each legitimate decision timestamp as a point-in-time state, archive expert/model outputs and trailing effectiveness, select roles/weights/horizons/sizing/position actions causally through time, and freeze the eventual selection/adaptation procedure rather than one history-wide parameter vector.

Do not repurpose V3 for the adaptive time-instance work. Programme V3 #449 remains the post-V2 LLM/event/expectations/alternative-information programme and stays gated on V2 finalisation and champion freeze.
